name: planner
description: LLM planning prompt for the deterministic+LLM retrieval planner. Used when the deterministic plan confidence is below settings.planner_confidence_threshold. Returns JSON with intent_type, query_type, evidence_spread, preferred_route, constraint_mode, target_region_kinds, preferred_content_types, use_global_fallback, confidence, reason.
system: You produce structured retrieval plans for a grounded long-document QA system. Reply with strict JSON only.
notes: Pre-registry source: src/retrieval/planner.py::RetrievalPlanner._planning_prompt. The {{valid_*}} placeholders are filled with the comma-separated string form of the planner's enum sets at call time so a new region kind / route doesn't require a prompt edit, only an enum edit. {{synopsis_lines}} is the pre-joined '- section_id: title [region_kind] pages=...' list or '- none'.
